To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the VSWR parameter is strongly affected by the shape of the connection between the stripline and the coaxial connector.
the VSWR is a function of the dimensions of the feeder in the point where the feeder is connected to the connector.

the VSWR is a function of the stripline width (W) and the distance of stripline from the connector (D) and that the best VSWR value is achieved when the distance of the stripline from the coaxial connector is 1.5 mm.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the optimization of the electrical properties of the stripline in the point of the connection to a coaxial connector.
the influence of the stripline geometry on the VSWR value and its optimization.
the design of a stripline with the best impedance match for the coaxial input/output connector.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
it is necessary to optimize dimensions of stripline feeder in terms of impedance matching to the coaxial connector.
the stripline feeder is not a simple transmission line, but a complicated structure with complex electromagnetic fields.
the stripline dimensions and shapes are very important for the EMC testing of automotive electrical components.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the stripline feeder should be as short as possible and the connection should be as close to the stripline feeder as it is allowed by the standard.

the best VSWR parameter was achieved by using the stripline feeder with the same width as the inner diameter of the coaxial connector and a length of the feeder which is equal or longer than the length of the connector.
it is possible to optimize the stripline feeder dimensions and shape to achieve the best electrical properties.
The main takeaway from our work is that
stripline feeder should be designed with impedance matching in mind, and that the stripline feeder should have an appropriate shape and dimensions in the point of the connector.
the VSWR value can be reduced to 1.1 or even 1.0, if the stripline feeder is properly dimensioned.
stripline feeder should be optimized in the shape and dimensions to achieve the 50 ohms impedance matching with the connector and to avoid VSWR higher than 1.5.
